questions.question: Is the FE exam a degree condition to take, or to pass? The text says it is required before graduating and describes passing it as the first step toward licensure.

Which CE courses numbered 400 or higher belong to each of the six sub-disciplines? The capture does not list them, so neither the four-of-six breadth rule nor the depth rule can be checked against courses.
The record's admission field is empty. Are there School of Engineering or departmental admission requirements for the B.S.C.E. that a board should show?
